task: Finish Narwhal#223 Phase 2 failure handling and macOS Local Network probe regressions

events.summary: Issue #223 reports a clean Apple-silicon VMware install where up.sh printed Phase 2 incomplete after five attempts and returned rc=0; each Phase 2 attempt also reported no route to host / EHOSTUNREACH while the host interface and 127.0.0.1 forwarded ports worked. The issue attributes the LAN failure to macOS Local Network Privacy on the terminal app.

Inspected scripts/cluster/06-phase2-start.sh: its critical-script failure branch already exits 1 after printing the failure message, so the issue's reported rc=0 was not reproduced from current source and no change was needed there.

Restricted Vagrant forwarded-port parsing to guest port 22 and made it emit only the first matching host port. Cached only a positive master-1 reachability result so failed/transient probes are retried.

Static regression suite passed all 208 checks with zero failures and four existing environment warnings; new R156 validates guest-port selection and positive-only caching, and mutation check R156b detected a loosened guest-port selector.
shellcheck --severity=warning passed for both changed shell scripts; bash -n passed for both changed shell scripts.
Sharpened the existing 2026-07-29 macOS Local Network lesson with the issue's Phase 2 silent-success discriminator and recorded the current-source check of 06-phase2-start.sh.
Requested source changes and operational trace are complete and locally verified; no commit or push performed.
